blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Every shipment needs a mode of transport. Each mode has its own balance of cost and speed. Road is flexible and goes almost door-to-door, but it is slower over long distances. Sea is very cheap for large volumes, but it takes weeks.

Air is fast, but it is expensive. Rail is efficient for big loads over land, but it is less flexible than road. For short trips, road wins. For long, heavy journeys, sea wins. For urgent and small shipments, air wins.

The cheapest option is rarely the right one if the clock is running.

items.q: Which mode goes almost door-to-door?
items.why: "Road is flexible and goes almost door-to-door."

items.q: According to the text, why is sea good for large volumes?
items.why: "Sea is very cheap for large volumes, but it takes weeks."

items.q: The text says rail is less flexible than…
items.why: "Rail... is less flexible than road."

items.q: For an urgent and small shipment, which mode would the writer most likely choose?
items.why: Inferência: "For urgent and small shipments, air wins." — air é rápido.

items.q: "The cheapest option is rarely the right one if the clock is running." This suggests that…
options: sea is always the best choice
cost is the only thing that matters
the fastest mode is always the cheapest
when time is short, you may need to pay more
items.why: Inferência: "the clock is running" = há pressa, então o mais barato pode não servir.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Oliver ajudando um novo coordenador a escolher o modal. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, come in, sit down. So you have some samples that need to go to a client in Singapore, right? And they are urgent. Good. Let's think about this together, step by step.

We have two main options here: sea or air. Sea is much cheaper than air. For big volumes of sugar, we almost always use sea. It is the cheapest mode we have. But there is a problem: sea is very slow. It takes weeks. And your client cannot wait weeks for these samples. They need them now.

Air is more expensive, that is true. But air is fast, and that is what matters today. Look at the box: it is small and it is light. So the cost is not so high, even by air. And remember, the client needs it this week. The clock is running.

So my advice is simple: for this shipment, choose air. It is the faster option, and the samples are small and light. Book it today and send me the details after lunch. Next time you have a big, heavy load with no rush, come and talk to me, and we will choose sea. Okay? Any questions?
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where do the samples need to go?
items.why: "you have samples that need to go to a client in Singapore".

items.q: Why does Oliver say the samples cannot go by sea?
options: The box is too big for a ship
Sea is too slow and takes weeks
There are no ships to Singapore
items.why: "Sea is slow. It takes weeks. Your client cannot wait weeks."

items.q: What does Oliver finally advise?
items.why: "for this shipment, choose air."

items.q: Why is the high cost of air not a big problem here?
options: Air is actually cheaper than sea
The box is small and light
The company has a lot of money
items.why: Inferência: "The box is small and light, so the cost is not so high."

items.q: When would Oliver probably use sea instead?
options: For a big, heavy load with no rush
items.why: Inferência: "Next time you have a big, heavy load with no rush, we talk about sea."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We need to choose the right mode of transport." A mode is…
options: a way or method (road, sea, air, rail)
items.why: Mode = modal, o meio de transporte.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Road is very ___ because it can change route and go almost anywhere."
items.why: Flexible = flexível, pode mudar e ir a quase qualquer lugar.

items.q: "The truck offers a door-to-door service." This means…
options: from the seller's door to the buyer's door
items.why: Door-to-door = porta a porta, do remetente ao destinatário.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Air freight is fast, but it is very ___."
items.why: Expensive = caro; o avião é rápido, porém caro.

items.q: "This shipment is urgent." This means it…
items.why: Urgent = urgente, precisa chegar logo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em conversas sobre logística e transporte. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager still has to sign off on the air shipment." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "Let's go ahead with air for these samples." To go ahead with means to…
options: start or continue with a plan
items.why: Go ahead with = seguir em frente com um plano.

items.q: "The client asked us to speed up the delivery." To speed up means to…
items.why: Speed up = acelerar, tornar mais rápido.

items.q: "The samples arrived late because the plane was held up at the airport." Held up means…
items.why: Held up = atrasado, retido.

items.q: "The clock is running, so we can't hold off on the decision." To hold off on means to…
items.why: Hold off on = adiar, esperar antes de agir.
